                    [32m' * @category Wasp Spec\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @example\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * import { app } from "@wasp.sh/spec"\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * export default app({\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   name: "todoApp",\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   title: "ToDo App",\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   wasp: { version: "^0.24.0" },\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   spec: [],\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * });\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface App {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Internal app name.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Must not contain spaces.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    name: string;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Wasp metadata.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * This will get checked against the Wasp CLI.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    wasp: Wasp;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * App title.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Used as the browser tab title.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    title: string;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Extra tags injected into the HTML `<head>`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Each entry is rendered inside a React component, so the strings must be\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * valid JSX: self-closing tags must end with `/>` (e.g. `<meta ... />`),\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * and attributes must be camelCased (e.g. `httpEquiv` instead of\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * `http-equiv`).\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Due to a [React bug](https://github.com/facebook/react/issues/36169),\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * avoid `defer` on `<script>` tags because it can cause hydration\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * warnings. Use `async` instead.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    head?: string[];\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Configuration for authentication. Enables auth when set. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    auth?: Auth;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Configuration for the server part of the resulting Wasp app. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    server?: Server;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Configuration for the client part of the resulting Wasp app. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    client?: Client;\n'[39m +
                    [32m"    /** Configuration for the app's database. */\n"[39m +
                    [32m'    db?: Db;\n'[39m +
                    [32m"    /** Configuration for the app's email sender. */\n"[39m +
                    [32m'    emailSender?: EmailSender;\n'[39m +
                    [32m"    /** Configuration for the app's WebSocket support. */\n"[39m +
                    [32m'    webSocket?: WebSocket;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * The specification ({@link Spec}) of the app.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Build entries with the dedicated constructors ({@link page}, {@link route},\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * {@link query}, {@link action}, {@link api}, {@link apiNamespace},\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * {@link job}, {@link crud}).\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    spec: Spec;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Wasp compiler metadata used by the app.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface Wasp {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * The Wasp version this app is built for, as an npm-compatible\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * [SemVer range](https://github.com/npm/node-semver#ranges)\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * (e.g. `"^0.24.0"`).\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    version: string;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Authentication configuration and lifecycle hooks.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * See the [Auth overview](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/overview) for the\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * supported auth methods and how the `User` entity is connected to auth.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * If hooks are async, Wasp awaits them. All hooks receive `prisma` and `req`\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * in their input. Hook return values are ignored except for\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * {@link AuthHooks.onBeforeOAuthRedirect}, which can change the redirect URL.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * In TypeScript, you can type each hook implementation with its matching\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * type from `wasp/server/auth` (e.g. `OnBeforeSignupHook`). See\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * [Auth Hooks](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/auth-hooks) for the full hook\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * inputs and examples.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @example\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * import { app } from "@wasp.sh/spec"\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * export default app({\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   // ...\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   auth: {\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     userEntity: "User",\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     methods: {\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *       usernameAndPassword: {}, // use this or email, not both\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *       google: {},\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *       gitHub: {},\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     },\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     onAuthFailedRedirectTo: "/login",\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   },\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * })\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface Auth extends AuthHooks {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Name of the Prisma model that represents the application user connected to\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * your business logic.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * The user entity needs to have an ID field that uniquely identifies each\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * user. It can be of any name and type, but it needs to be marked with `@id`:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ```prisma title="schema.prisma"\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * model User {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *   id Int @id @default(autoincrement())\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * You can add any other fields you want to the user entity. Make sure to also\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * define them in the `userSignupFields` field if they need to be set during\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * the sign-up process.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * See [Accessing User Data](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/entities) for how the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * user entity connects to the rest of the auth system.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    userEntity: EntityName;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Enabled authentication methods. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    methods: AuthMethods;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Route that Wasp redirects unauthenticated users to when they try to\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * access a page that has `authRequired: true`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * See [Adding Auth to the Project](https://wasp.sh/docs/tutorial/auth#adding-auth-to-the-project)\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * for an example.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAuthFailedRedirectTo: string;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Route that Wasp redirects users to after a successful login or signup.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m"     * Only takes effect when using Wasp's built-in Auth UI.\n"[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * See [Auth UI](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/ui).\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @default "/"\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAuthSucceededRedirectTo?: string;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'interface AuthHooks {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called before the user is created. Receives `providerId` plus the common\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * hook input. Throw from this hook to reject a signup based on custom\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * criteria.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onBeforeSignup?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called after the user is created. Receives `providerId`, the created\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * `user`, and, for social auth, `oauth` fields including tokens and the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * unique OAuth request ID.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAfterSignup?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Called once, after the user verifies their email. Receives `email` and `user`. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAfterEmailVerified?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called before redirecting the user to the OAuth provider. Receives the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * generated `url` and `oauth.uniqueRequestId`. Return `{ url }` to override\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * the redirect URL.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onBeforeOAuthRedirect?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called before the user is logged in. Receives `providerId` and `user`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Throw from this hook to reject a login based on custom criteria.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onBeforeLogin?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called after a successful login. Receives `providerId`, `user`, and, for\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * social auth, `oauth` fields including tokens and the unique OAuth request\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ID.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAfterLogin?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Enabled authentication methods for the app.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * At most one local auth method ({@link LocalAuthMethods}) can be used, but you\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * can enable as many external auth methods ({@link ExternalAuthMethods}) as you\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * need.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export type AuthMethods = RequireOneOrNone<LocalAuthMethods> & ExternalAuthMethods;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Built-in local auth methods.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Pick at most one of these.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface LocalAuthMethods {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Enables username and password auth. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    usernameAndPassword: UsernameAndPasswordConfig;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Enables email and password auth with email verification and password\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * reset flows.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    email: EmailAuthConfig;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Social (OAuth) auth methods.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Each enabled provider also requires the matching client ID and secret to\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * be set as environment variables. See the\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * [Social Auth overview](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/social-auth/overview) for\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * details on each provider.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface ExternalAuthMethods extends Partial<Record<SocialAuthMethodName, SocialAuthConfig>> {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Supported social auth providers.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'type SocialAuthMethodName = "discord" | "google" | "gitHub" | "keycloak" | "microsoft" | "slack";\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Username and password auth configuration.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @example\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * import { app } from "@wasp.sh/spec"\n'[39m +

                    [32m' *\n'[39m +

                    [32m' *   },\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * })\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface UsernameAndPasswordConfig extends BaseAuthMethodConfig {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +

                    [32m" * By default, Wasp stores only the user's provider-specific ID. Use\n"[39m +

                    [32m' *\n'[39m +

                    [32m'export declare function job(fn: Job["fn"], config: JobConfig): Job;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +

                      [32m'```\n'[39m +

                      [32m'...\n'[39m +

                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
                      [32m'wasp db start\n'[39m +
                      [32m'```\n'[39m +
